input_policy: Exactly four literal approved wheel names/SHA256/sizes; no CLI pin/version/owner/network/install override
Held nofollow fds with UID1000/mode0600/nlink1, full hash before ZIP parsing and same inode/stat through copy and exit
Root-or-UID1000 controlled no022 ancestor traversal; project namespace only
zip_policy: Bounded central inventory/member bytes/total bytes/compression/path lengths; CRC and complete RECORD SHA256/size validation
Reject paths/duplicates/traversal/.pth/.pyc/__pycache__/dotenv/credential directories/links/special/encryption; .data is denied except the exact opaque greenlet header group below
Reject duplicates and parent-file collisions across all four archives before output creation
Read metadata and payload only through zipfile streams; no package import or entrypoint/pip execution
publication: Exclusive new output+intent; O_EXCL/NOFOLLOW data files and parent directory fd writes
Preserve originals and any partial output; never overwrite, delete, resume or replay a prior attempt
Fsync data and complete inventory; exit-stat all input fds; only then write manifest and receipt
Runtime manifest exact keys version/site_root/source_wheels/files; every regular file has relative SHA256/bytes

vendor_node_policy.required_future_native_evidence: Actual executable path+SHA256 used by Playwright; not a chmod assertion

not_an_installation: Data tree only, not pip-installed or root-staged; wheel content paths/bytes retained, file/dir modes and timestamps explicitly transformed
Frozen qa/python-runtime.json remains untouched; generated manifest is a future review candidate only
Root installer must separately revalidate closure, normalize approved public ownership/modes while preserving vendor Node without execute bits, and bind sealed launcher/env

output_identity_anchoring.lexical_reopen: _parent NOFOLLOW/no022 then original root/sites entries; no writes through reopened replacements
checkpoints: after final fsync before successful return
output_identity_anchoring.on_mismatch: fail; preserve original partial; never initialize/write replacement
output_identity_anchoring.late_rename_after_receipt_write: Original fd may retain candidate receipt bytes, but final check fails and no success is acknowledged; future adoption must revalidate the agreed lexical path and identities

opaque_greenlet_header.retention: original bytes and RECORD at original member paths as opaque DATA; included in future manifest.files
